user.title: Fuel Forecast
user.description: Pick the price sensors of the stations you use for one fuel type (for example from Tankerkönig). Fuel Forecast learns when each of them is usually cheapest and tells you whether to fill up now or wait.

data.name: Name
data.min_saving: Minimum saving to wait for (cents per litre)
data.urgent_level: Fill up now below fuel level

data_description.stations: All sensors must report the same unit. Only the existing sensors are read, no extra requests are sent to the price service.
data_description.min_saving: Only recommend waiting if the expected price is at least this much lower.
data_description.fuel_level_entity: A sensor in % or in litres (litres need the tank size).

error.station_not_found: One of the selected sensors does not exist.
error.mixed_units: The selected sensors use different units.
error.levels: The urgent fuel level must be below the no-recommendation level.
